description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

cases.title: Applying a filter narrows the product list to matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list is available and contains <products with differing values for a filterable attribute, e.g. several that match the filter value and several that do not>.
steps: Note the products shown before filtering.
Apply <a filter with a value that matches some but not all of the listed products>.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed: only products matching the applied filter value are shown, and products that do not match are no longer listed.

cases.title: Filter value that matches no products
cases.preconditions: The product list is available and contains <products, none of which match the filter value to be used>.
steps: Apply <a filter with a value that no product in the list matches>.
cases.expected: No products are shown, since none match the filter. The exact empty-result message or display is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Filter value that matches every product
cases.preconditions: The product list is available and contains <products that all share the same value for a filterable attribute>.
steps: Note the products shown before filtering.
Apply <a filter with a value that all listed products match>.
cases.expected: All products are still shown, since every product matches the filter; no matching product is removed from the list.

cases.title: Product list without any filter applied
cases.preconditions: The product list is available and contains <several products with differing values for a filterable attribute>.
steps: Open the product list without applying any filter.
cases.expected: The list is not narrowed: all products are shown.
